methodology: Conservative brief action labels from separately identified CatholicCulture reproductions of historical Catholic family-life books; not complete original books; exact printed pages not inspected. Source lines only tentative web excerpt range hints and must be rechecked if host changes. One act per record; closely related acts can be variants of a single custom and many descriptions are personal suggestions. No claim of independently verified distinct practices or separate author corroboration.
copyright_policy: Only original concise action labels are retained, never bulk recipes, prayer texts, or verbatim chapters.
author_dependency_warning: Trapp and Berger are quoted or paraphrased by Stokes, McLoughlin, and Weiser. Newland borrows Berger recipes and other sources. Treat each attribution and underlying provenance as a review requirement; multiple web pages are not independent sources when they reproduce one author.
